synthesis: Two unrelated defects on the Zone Manager (/app/manage-zones). (1) CONTRAST: the Filament panel's `primary` colour token is a degenerate ramp - shades 100-950 are all the literal hex #FF6666, and shade 50 (#FBE9F5) is a leftover fuchsia from the pre-2025 palette. Any component pairing two primary shades for background and text therefore renders the same colour twice. Introduced by commit 03c473f80 'Updates: colors' (2025-03-31), a partial rebrand from fuchsia to coral that flattened shades 300-950 while the SAME diff correctly used Color::hex() for `info` and `danger` - so this is a mistake, not a deliberate accessibility choice, and nothing in okf/ documents it. (2) INTERACTION: ZIP-derived (premade) GeoZone boundaries render as plain non-editable google.maps.Polygon overlays whose ONLY click listener calls removeZip(), which does overlay.setMap(null). Drawn polygons take a different path (editablePolygonStyle + attachEditablePolygonHandlers, editable:true) and are never wired to delete-on-click. ZIP boundaries are NOT stored geometry - they are re-derived from definition.zip_codes against tiger_data.zcta5_all on every render AND every save - so an edited premade shape has nowhere to persist to today.

scope.summary: Fix the degenerate `primary` colour token so every chip consumer resolves to real, differentiated shades; and change the ZIP-derived map overlay's plain click from destructive-remove to select. The persistence half of the map fix (AC5/AC6) is blocked on a Product decision the ticket itself defers.

questions.q: When a premade (ZIP-derived) GeoZone boundary is hand-edited, what happens to the source ZIP? (a) DETACH - snapshot the shape into definition.polygons and drop the ZIP from definition.zip_codes; zero schema change, reuses the existing save path, but the ZIP chip disappears. (b) KEEP WITH OVERRIDE - leave the ZIP in zip_codes but stop re-deriving it once an override polygon exists; needs a correlation marker that the {polygons, zip_codes} shape does not have today, plus a rebuildGeometryFromDefinition() change to avoid unioning both the original and edited areas. (c) DISALLOW - block the edit behind a confirmation that explains it detaches the ZIP.
questions.answer: DETACH. On first vertex edit, snapshot the shape into definition.polygons and remove that ZIP from definition.zip_codes. Zero schema change; reuses the existing save path verbatim. Consequence: the ZIP chip disappears once its shape is edited - surface this in QA and consider a non-blocking toast.

questions.q: Scope of the contrast fix: (a) fix the shared `primary` token in PlatformPanelProvider.php - one line, fixes ~20 chip sites across BOTH the /app and /client panels, satisfies AC3 and AC9 properly, but the token is a TRAIT used by both panels so primary buttons and links change appearance app-wide and customer-facing; or (b) a CSS override scoped to chip selectors only - no button/link change, but leaves the underlying token broken and is a weaker reading of AC3.
questions.answer: CSS OVERRIDE, CHIPS ONLY. Do NOT change the `primary` token in PlatformPanelProvider.php - buttons and links must not shift in either panel. Scope the fix to chip selectors in resources/css/filament/app/theme.css, covering BOTH the Filament Select multi-value badge (.fi-badge.fi-color-primary, which reaches all ~20 sites in both panels) and the hand-rolled ZIP chip in manage-zones.blade.php.

questions.q: AC4/AC5 sequencing: AC5 and AC6 are blocked, but AC4 as written requires the selected shape to DISPLAY EDIT HANDLES. Handles that can be dragged while persistence is unbuilt means a user drags a vertex, sees it move, saves, and silently loses the change - arguably worse than today's delete-on-click. (a) ship AC4 as select-and-highlight WITHOUT drag handles now, and land handles with the persistence work; or (b) hold all of defect 2 until the storage decision lands, shipping only the contrast fix in this hotfix.
questions.answer: FULL HANDLES NOW. Ship AC4 as written. This is safe BECAUSE question[0] was answered DETACH: edits now persist through definition.polygons, so the silent-data-loss risk that made handles dangerous no longer exists. AC5 and AC6 are therefore IN SCOPE for this ticket, not deferred.

questions.q: Are ZIP-derived boundaries stored as editable geometry or re-derived per render?
questions.answer: Re-derived, on both sides. definition.zip_codes holds only ZIP strings. Client: hydrateZips() re-fetches each boundary via ZoneZipSearchController -> Zone::searchZipCodes() every edit session. Server: Zone::rebuildGeometryFromDefinition() re-unions tiger_data.zcta5_all into geom on every save. There is no column or JSON key for an edited ZIP shape. All three deep candidates agreed independently.

questions.q: Can the Filament Select multi-value badge colour be overridden per field from app code?
questions.answer: No. The class string 'fi-badge fi-size-md fi-color fi-color-primary fi-text-color-600 dark:fi-text-color-200' is hardcoded in vendor/filament/support/resources/js/utilities/select.js:751 and in the compiled vendor/filament/forms/dist/components/select.js. It bypasses BadgeComponent::getColorMap() entirely, so no ->color() API reaches it. Driver-verified from vendor source; this resolved a disagreement between deep candidates (one had claimed getColorMap applies and yields a passing 5.67:1 - that path governs the Blade badge/TagsInput, not the JS Select chips).

questions.q: Was the flat primary palette intentional?
questions.answer: No. Commit 03c473f80 'Updates: colors' (2025-03-31) rebranded fuchsia->coral by flattening shades 300-950 to '#ff6666' while leaving 50/100/200 as the old fuchsia values, and the SAME diff added Color::hex() correctly for 'info' and 'danger'. Shades 100/200 were flattened later. Nothing in okf/ documents it as deliberate.

No JS test runner exists in this repo. tests/Filament/Pages/ManageZonesTest.php's own docblock says the polygon drawing is JS and covered by Agent QA. Defect 2's map interaction cannot get PHPUnit coverage; only the definition-persistence boundary can.

The AC9 shortfall is the single most missable thing in this ticket: the obvious one-line token fix looks like it fixes every chip, and it does not fix the one the reporter explicitly amended the ACs for. Two independent derivations put it at 4.02:1.

Primary buttons and links resolve their shade through Filament's contrast-aware ButtonComponent::getColorMap(), which is currently fed a degenerate ramp. After the fix it gets a real one, so button appearance will shift (most likely darker, toward shade-600 #D14C4D) across both panels. The brand shade-500 itself barely moves: #FF6666 -> #F06765.

OPERATOR DECISION consequence: because the `primary` token is left degenerate, the four 'Pro' badges and every other primary-shade pairing stay broken, and any NEW chip added later is broken by default. This is an accepted trade for hotfix stability. It should become a follow-up ticket.

UX consequence of DETACH: the ZIP chip vanishes from the list the moment its shape is edited. Not a defect, but it is unexplained to the user; a non-blocking toast is worth considering in the plan and must be called out in human QA.

qa_hint.seed_scenario: One org (org_id=2), one ADMIN user (ZonePolicy requires ADMIN + same-org) who also has a kit_settings row so the Assigned Kit Users chip renders. BLOCKER this seed must solve: tiger_data.zcta5_all is EMPTY (0 rows), and Zone::searchZipCodes() reads it to render every ZIP-derived boundary - with no rows NO ZIP shape can appear on the map at all and AC4/AC5/AC6/AC7 cannot be exercised. Seed at least three ZCTAs into tiger_data.zcta5_all (geometry column is MULTIPOLYGON, SRID 4269; searchZipCodes does ST_Transform(the_geom,4326)): (a) a simple single-ring ZCTA, (b) a MULTI-RING DONUT ZCTA so the interior-ring fix can actually be observed, (c) a DENSE ZCTA of >2000 boundary points to exercise the editable vertex cap. Recipe incl. the spatial_ref_sys SRID 4269 row: tests/Models/ZoneTest.php::seedTigerZip(). platform.zones is also empty - seed a zone in org 2 carrying BOTH a drawn polygon in definition.polygons AND at least one seeded ZIP in definition.zip_codes, with geom rebuilt, plus a platform.zone_user row attaching the kit user.

grounding.code_flow: ManageZones::mount()/loadZone() hydrates the Livewire form from Zone::definition and dispatches 'zone-selected' -> zone-manager.js beginEdit() renders definition.polygons as editable google.maps.Polygon objects and re-fetches each ZIP boundary via ZoneZipSearchController -> Zone::searchZipCodes() (tiger_data.zcta5_all), rendering those as non-editable overlays whose only listener deletes. Edits call syncEditingState(), which serialises polygonOverlays back into definition.polygons. ManageZones::save() persists definition and calls Zone::rebuildGeometryFromDefinition(), which re-unions the ZIP geometry fresh and merges it with the stored polygons into the PostGIS geom column, then ZoneAssignmentSyncer and ZoneBroadcaster run.
